# Shibumi Forms

> Form backend for static sites. Plain HTML in front, one container and one SQLite database behind it. Hosted free at https://forms.shibumistack.dev; MIT-licensed self-hosted core.

## Pages

- [About](/about.md): why it exists, hosted terms, donations

## Docs

- [Overview](/docs/index.md)
- [Connect your form](/docs/connect-form.md): endpoint, snippet, honeypot, accepted content
- [JSON API](/docs/json-api.md): fetch posts, CORS, response codes
- [Self-hosting](/docs/self-hosting.md): container, compose, environment variables
- [Backup and restore](/docs/backup-restore.md)
- [Limits](/docs/limits.md): hosted quotas and rate limits
- [Security and data handling](/docs/security.md)
